posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md:
finally after a year of playing around with this home built laser project i got some very good results result .

![Image](http://www.geocities.com/greenpagoda/diode2.jpg)

the diode is a mitsubishi ML1016R with the window removed,the beam quality is fantastic. i plan on doing some neat, one beam setups...

i am powering it with 4 "D" size rechargeable MH batterys (it wll run for at least 5 hours or more), eventualy i will test to see how much loss of power vs time...... (look out cave holograms!)

the simple circut with the ic chip cost me less than $20 to build ,i purchased all parts at the radio shack and the IC chip came with the laser diode 

i wasted a lot of time trying to set up a regulated ac-dc power supply ,so i decided to back-track and try the battery power supply. i just got some great results doing a test shot with some old film (8e75hd), im have trouble uploading pictures tonight so ill try to post some pict. tomorrow

posts.author: John Klayer
posts.content_md: Did you get the diode and chip from Frank? Why did you remove the window? How did you remove the window?

posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md:
> **John Klayer:** Did you get the diode and chip from Frank? Why did you remove the window? How did you remove the window?

the reason for window removal was to get a very clean beam and

i was thinking about the "sliced bread thing" .

they make a tool to remove the diode tops, its kinda like a mini-can opener, i used a sharp wire stripper, the kind where the wire fits into a "V"notch. i clamped as high up the side of the can(lightly) and start to rotate it ,just keep applying pressure and spinning and be careful ,sooner or later you will cut thru, once it starts to go ,stop rotating and pry it off!

i got the diode and chip from my bro-in-law (he sells LEDs world-wide and got them as a frebee) i tried to buy some ,but nobody stocks them??

he is trying to get me more......please stand by

posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md:
> **Dinesh:** What's the coherence length?

i set an 2" mirror in the forground of my test transmission shot,(about 17" behind the film plane), and i can easly make out the backside of my setup.so the coherence is at least twice the 17".

i would like to set up a interfrometer, but with the gassious shaped output ,it seems to difficult to do.

tonight i testing to find correct exposure.the film is 8e75hd w D-19 developer using a pyrochrome bleach.
